answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. The island is small, but the toll is $68 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. The desk only stamps a name that carries Maplebound lute guide ivory writ, and the stamp itself rests on a writ lute guides sign after music office audits. One reef, one entry.
